description_excerpt: Job Description WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON Main challenge You will help build and improve a kid-safe AI chatbot in a children's app that is live in many languages. Your main focus is the LLM-powered chatbot. Its answers must be friendly, consistent, age-appropriate and safe in every supported language. Depending on project needs, you will also work on computer vision (recognizing real-world toys), generative illustration pipelines, and translation and text-to-speech automation. benefits: Internship allowance from VND 6,000,000 gross/month (based on candidates' competencies and committed working days).
1 day of paid annual leave per month, Christmas leave, Birthday leave, CSR leave, paid sick leave.
Various training packages, including internal training and e-learning platforms (iLearn, Udemy, O'Reilly,...).
Opportunities to collaborate and train with Gameloft worldwide experts and develop yourselves.
A range of well-being events and policies to support employees physically, mentally, and emotionally.
The opportunity to become an official employee of Gameloft.
